title: Layer 3 round 1 major SE+UX convergent: broken members of the composed display render with no repo identity — indistinguishable lines; segment_for_repo untested

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in ff331dd9: the composition root's broken arm prefixes the worded repo name (the acquisition's own leaf derivation) to the registered mark, so every composed line — healthy or broken — identifies its repo; the single-repo broken glance gains the same identity.
